SESSION	create temporary view data as select * from values
READ	select a, udaf(b) from data group by 1
READ	select 1, 2, udaf(b) from data group by 1, 2
READ	select a, 1, udaf(b) from data group by a, 1
READ	select a, 1, udaf(b) from data group by 1, 2
READ	select a, b + 2, udaf(2) from data group by a, 2
READ	select a as aa, b + 2 as bb, udaf(2) from data group by 1, 2
READ	select udaf(b) from data group by 1 + 0
READ	select a, b, udaf(b) from data group by 3
READ	select a, b, udaf(b) + 2 from data group by 3
READ	select a, rand(0), udaf(b)
READ	select a, udaf(a) from (select 1 as a) tmp group by 1 order by 1
READ	select udaf(a), a from (select 1 as a) tmp group by 2 having a > 0
READ	select a, a AS k, udaf(b) from data group by k, 1
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by cube(1, 2)
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by cube(1, b)
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by 1, 2 with cube
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by rollup(1, 2)
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by rollup(1, b)
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by 1, 2 with rollup
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by grouping sets((1), (2), (1, 2))
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by grouping sets((1), (b), (a, 2))
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by a, 2 grouping sets((1), (b), (a, 2))
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by a, -1
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by a, 3
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by cube(-1, 2)
READ	select a, b, udaf(1) from data group by cube(1, 3)
SESSION	set spark.sql.groupByOrdinal=false
READ	select udaf(b) from data group by -1
